# CANDIDATE: TURN_OF_MONTH_VWAP_BOUNCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Turn-of-month bullish bias causes SPY to exhibit mean-reverting behavior toward the intraday VWAP on the last trading day of the month. This edge exists due to institutional rebalancing flows and retail participation patterns that create predictable VWAP attraction at month-end, particularly when price opens near prior VWAP and shows early upward momentum with confirming volume.

## Mechanism

Entry: Trigger fires when (1) today is the last trading day of the month, (2) SPY opens within 0.2% of prior day's VWAP, (3) price crosses above VWAP with 5-minute bar volume exceeding the average 5-minute volume of the prior 20 bars. Enter long at the close of the bar that first closes above VWAP. Exit: Initial stop at prior day's VWAP (or intraday low if lower) for invalidation. Take profit 1 at 1.5R, then trail the runner at 10% below the highest watermark. Avoid FOMC days and require EMA50 > EMA20 (200-day EMA proxy) to avoid strong downtrends.

2. **Sample bias:** Zero-sample proposal based on calendar/VWAP hypothesis; no historical validation performed; extreme overfit risk due to curve-fitting potential on monthly seasonality.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).

5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw losses on choppy month-end days; max drawdown: consecutive losing month-ends could erode 20%+ of capital; blow-up scenario: volatility expansion (e.g., FOMC) triggering stop outs during gap moves.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (no data to compute top-5 days contribution).
